subject.title: Add comprehensive AWS deployment guide (EC2, ECS, Lambda)

question: Which AWS deployment topologies should official OpenClaw docs support for this issue: EC2/Lightsail with Docker Compose first, ECS/Fargate, EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, or only a reviewed external AWS sample link?
rationale: The requested guide would become public production advice for gateway exposure, authentication, IAM/task roles, secret storage, persistent state, backups, and serverless support, so automation should not choose those defaults without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: EC2/Docker Compose first
options.body: Document EC2 or Lightsail with Docker Compose as the primary supported AWS path, then add brief ECS/Fargate, EKS, and Lambda applicability notes.

options.title: Link external sample only
options.body: Point to a reviewed AWS sample repository and avoid owning official ECS/Lambda instructions until maintainers validate them.

options.title: Full AWS matrix
options.body: Own EC2, ECS/Fargate, EKS, and Lambda guidance in OpenClaw docs, accepting broader security and support review cost.

recommendation.title: EC2/Docker Compose first
recommendation.body: Document EC2 or Lightsail with Docker Compose as the primary supported AWS path, then add brief ECS/Fargate, EKS, and Lambda applicability notes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current docs blame and Peter's prior issue review put him closest to the docs/product-scope decision.
